SELECT
  toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfSecond(timestamp)) AS s,
  count() AS n,
  anyHeavy(log_attributes['parsed.query']) AS q
FROM logs
WHERE source = 'postgres_logs'
  AND event_message LIKE '%canceling statement due to statement timeout%'
  AND {{time_filter}}
GROUP BY s
ORDER BY s
